title: Fever in adults — self-care and when to get help
content: A high temperature is usually considered to be 38C (100.4F) or above. Self-care includes resting, drinking plenty of fluids to avoid dehydration, and taking paracetamol or ibuprofen if uncomfortable. Ask for an urgent GP appointment or contact NHS 111 if you have been treating a high temperature at home but it is not getting better, or is getting worse. Try to stay at home and avoid contact with others until the high temperature resolves.
